problem: I'm analysing the baskets of goods and services used to measure consumer price inflation by the Office of National Statistics. On the ONS website, in the tables showing the allocation of items to 'Consumer Prices Index including owner occupiers' housing costs' (CPIH) divisions for 2020-2024 (inclusive), which categories, if any, experienced fluctuations in figures of representative items (per cent of total) over the course of this period? List the categories in alphabetical order, separated by a comma and a space.
answer: Clothing & footwear, Food & non-alcoholic beverages, Housing & household services, Miscellaneous goods and services, Restaurants & hotels, Transport
